name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers in case of crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
benefits: Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi crops. Rest paid by government.
eligibility: All farmers growing notified crops. Compulsory for loanee farmers, voluntary for non-loanee farmers.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana
description: Scheme to expand cultivable area under irrigation, improve water use efficiency and adopt precision-irrigation technologies.
benefits: Subsidies for drip/sprinkler irrigation, farm ponds, watershed development.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Self Help Groups, Incorporated companies, Farmer Producer Organizations.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support scheme providing ₹6000 per year in three equal installments directly to farmer bank accounts.
benefits: ₹6000 per year in 3 installments of ₹2000 each.
eligibility: All landholding farmers. Must have valid Aadhaar card and bank account linked to Aadhaar.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support for cultivation and other needs to farmers.
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 7% interest. Additional 3% subvention for timely repayment.
eligibility: All farmers including tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides soil health cards to farmers every 2 years with crop-wise recommendations on nutrients and fertilizers.
benefits: Free soil testing and personalized recommendations for nutrient management.
eligibility: All farmers can get their soil tested through government agriculture departments.

name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes organic farming and reduces use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
benefits: ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years. Support for certification, marketing.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming in cluster approach.

name: Minimum Support Price (MSP)
description: Government announces MSP for 23 crops to ensure farmers get remunerative prices.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum price for crops like wheat, rice, cotton, pulses, oilseeds.
eligibility: All farmers can sell at MSP through government procurement centers.

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Udyog Yojana
description: State scheme providing subsidies for agricultural equipment and modernization.
benefits: 50% subsidy on agricultural equipment up to ₹100,000.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Uttar Pradesh.

name: Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation (KALIA)
description: Financial assistance for small farmers, landless agricultural households and vulnerable groups.
benefits: ₹10,000 per family for cultivation, ₹12,500 for livelihood support.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural workers of Odisha.

name: Rythu Bandhu Scheme
description: Investment support for agricultural inputs to all farmers.
benefits: ₹10,000 per acre per year in two installments (₹5,000 each for Kharif and Rabi).
eligibility: All farmers of Telangana owning agricultural land.

name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
description: Incentivizes states to increase public investment in agriculture and allied sectors.
benefits: Flexible funds for agriculture development, infrastructure, mechanization.
eligibility: State governments implement various sub-schemes for farmers.

name: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
description: Aims to increase production and productivity of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and commercial crops.
benefits: Subsidies on seeds, fertilizers, farm equipment. Technical guidance and training.
eligibility: Farmers in identified districts for specific crops.
